body:
### Features
- **General:** Expose plugin name and options types [#9637](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9637)
- **LLM Observability:** Add submit feedback method for submitting end-user feedback [#9654](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9654)
- **pg:** Trace pool connection-acquire wait time [#8914](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/8914)
- **Test Optimization:** Add zero-config test impact analysis [#9604](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9604)
- **Test Optimization:** Improve validation runbook reliability [#9584](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9584)
- **Test Optimization:** Report managed tests in CI logs [#9605](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9605)
- **Test Optimization:** Support WebdriverIO Jasmine reporting [#9607](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9607)

### Fixes
- **dns:** Preserve shorthand rrtype with options [#9624](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9624)
- **express:** Preserve legacy middleware dispatch semantics [#9351](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9351)
- **loader:** Install the import-in-the-middle matcher under --loader [#9549](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9549)
- **mysql:** Preserve query callback arguments [#9630](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9630)
- **next:** Preserve http endpoint for parent spans [#9682](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9682)
- **next:** Trace compiled route runtimes [#9627](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9627)
- **Test Optimization:** Align EFD retries with duration policies [#9382](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9382)
- **Test Optimization:** Allow null skippable coverage metadata [#9677](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9677)
- **Test Optimization:** Avoid requesting page fixture in cleanup hook [#9681](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9681)
- **Test Optimization:** Disable telemetry in test workers [#9687](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9687)
- **Test Optimization:** Explain when TIA skips all tests [#9671](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9671)
- **Test Optimization:** Handle bounded validation edge cases [#9658](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9658)
- **Test Optimization:** Ignore line coverage for Vitest TIA [#9672](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9672)
- **Test Optimization:** Preserve Jest parameters across retries [#9693](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9693)
- **Test Optimization:** Preserve managed report details [#9653](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9653)
- **Test Optimization:** Reject symlinked coverage reports [#9335](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9335)
- **Test Optimization:** Support Jest 24 retry registration [#9699](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9699)
- **Test Optimization:** Support older Jest and Mocha versions [#9695](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9695)

### Performance
- **loader:** Defer rewriter initialization [#9502](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9502)

### Documentation
- **LLM Observability:** Correct both agent skills against the codebase [#9545](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9545)

### Internal (CI, Testing, Benchmarking)
- **AppSec:** Slim down appsec index file [#9670](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9670)
- **coverage:** Group equivalent V8 profiles before conversion [#9655](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9655)
- **Dependencies:** Bump @types/node [#9615](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9615)
- **Dependencies:** Bump openai [#9664](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9664)
- **Dependencies:** Bump pnpm [#9666](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9666)
- **Dependencies:** Bump pprof-format from 2.2.3 to 2.3.0 in /vendor in the vendor-minor-and-patch-dependencies group across 1 directory [#9690](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9690)
- **Dependencies:** Bump undici [#9663](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9663)
- **eslint:** Enable JSDoc parameter and type checks [#9566](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9566)
- **eslint:** Enable rules that are clean or trivially fixable [#9553](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9553)
- **eslint:** Update Unicorn and enable iteration fallback style [#9673](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9673)
- **General:** Reset the propagation-hash config on close [#9562](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9562)
- **General:** Support Node 24 iteration metrics [#9662](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9662)
- **lint:** Simplify regexes and enable the actionlint shellcheck pass [#9618](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9618)
- **LLM Observability:** Add preserve OpenTelemetry span receiver test [#9309](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9309)
- **Test Optimization:** Respect v5 Cypress support range [#9697](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9697)
- **Test Optimization:** Split Vitest TIA tests [#9652](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9652)
- **Test Optimization:** Stabilize flaky integration tests [#9650](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9650)
